description: Record Platform cold-bootstrap DAG: A.toolchain→A.workspace→P0.hard_reset→Z.colima_clean→P1.host_deps→B.crypto→…→J. P0 is the destructive boundary; F.cluster_deploy ensures (never deletes) record-platform unless RP_FORCE_NAMESPACE_DELETE=1.

A.workspace.description: Workspace determinism (pip==26.1.1, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run build, kafka-contract dist)

A.namespace_integrity_static.description: Fail-closed static scan: source/config/tests/proxy/OTel/metrics must have zero active legacy namespace hits before image build

F.namespace_integrity_runtime.description: Fail-closed runtime scan: live K8s objects, proxy/OTel config, MetalLB Jaeger exact-trace freshness with zero forbidden namespace

P1.host_deps.description: Host: node 22 + pnpm 11.1.3, docker, curl HTTP/3, openssl, kubectl, pip==26.1.1 venv

P0.hard_reset.description: Kill proof/preflight jobs; colima stop/delete; rm ~/.colima (no start)

Z.colima_clean.description: Start Colima+k3s, k3s settle, VM tcpdump/tshark/htop/strace/xcaddy, bridge kubeconfig

B.crypto.description: rp-bootstrap-crypto: 3-stage PKI, contract service leaves, audit-rp-cert-coverage, strict-tls-bootstrap, K8s TLS secrets audit, Kafka chain, webapp/ollama policy gates

B.kafka_client_pki.generate.description: Generate 12 dedicated clientAuth-only Kafka client leaves (kafka-client-tls namespace; not service-tls)

B.kafka_client_pki.verify.description: Verify clientAuth-only, SPIFFE SAN, chain, key match, distinct fingerprints for 12 Kafka client leaves

D.kafka_client_secrets.materialize.description: Materialize kafka-client-tls-<service> Secrets (private keys never committed)

F.kafka_client_workloads.wire.description: Wire 12 participants to /etc/kafka/client from kafka-client-tls-*; fail if shared client.crt remains

G.kafka_authorizer.configure.description: Lockout-safe StandardAuthorizer preflight only — does not enable authorizer until explicit enablement gate

G.kafka_acls.bootstrap.description: Offline ACL manifest validation from exact User:O=Record Platform,CN=<service> principals — apply deferred

H.kafka_identity_canary.description: Pre-v7 12-service / 19-role identity+ACL canary (authorized only after authorizer enablement)

I.kafka_three_broker_acceptance.description: Three-broker positive/negative mTLS+ACL matrix (authorized only after canary PASS)

C.infra.description: Host substrate: stop RP containers, compose 5433–5443, Redis 6379, MinIO

D.backup_materialization.description: Hybrid backup materialize + validate (11 DBs × 4 artifacts, no booking/social)

C.image_contract.description: Static Docker image contracts (pnpm 11, webapp standalone) before cluster deploy

D.contract_audits.description: RP runtime/gateway/probe/health + audit-rp-cert-coverage (11 mTLS leaves from contract) before image build

E.build_images.description: Build all active :dev images with per-service RP_SOURCE_SHA labels (make build-images)

E.image_freshness.description: Local image labels match current source SHA (audit-rp-image-freshness.sh; blocks stale trust/gateway rollouts)

F.cluster_deploy.description: make bootstrap (P2–P9): KRaft, deploy, P7a Ollama stack when RP_ENABLE_OLLAMA=1, endpoint wait, K8s TLS re-audit

G.app_runtime.description: RP services only: rollouts + /healthz + latency percentiles

H.observability.description: Prometheus/Grafana/Jaeger/OTel RP-named dashboards (umbrella; prefer granular H.observability.* nodes)

H.observability.deploy.description: Apply observability namespace resources (otel-collector, jaeger, prometheus, grafana, jaeger-query MetalLB)

H.observability.otel_ingestion.description: OTel Collector ClusterIP ready; app OTLP must target otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local

H.observability.jaeger_query_metallb.description: Jaeger Query MetalLB Service assigned declared IP (contract rp-jaeger-query-endpoint-contract.json)

H.observability.external_tls.description: jaeger.record-platform.test TLS leaf/intermediate/root + hostname/SNI verification via MetalLB

H.observability.trace_round_trip.description: Emit canary span via collector; retrieve exact trace ID through MetalLB Jaeger Query URL

I.transport.description: caddy-h3 MetalLB IP → /etc/hosts gate (pause; no edge smoke until hosts updated)

J.final_contract.description: Post-hosts: cluster-doctor + verify-bootstrap-state + drift + SLO/SLA (run via make cold-bootstrap-post-hosts)
